summary: The school district expresses strong opposition to the idea of tying E-Rate funding to federal mandates regarding screen time or device management, emphasizing the critical role of E-Rate funding in maintaining essential infrastructure for their rural district. The IT Director of Colstrip Public Schools urges the FCC to preserve Category 1 and Category 2 E-Rate funding without imposing additional restrictions, emphasizing the district's fiscal survival and the historical success of E-Rate in providing affordable broadband to rural schools.
